defects.title: An LP status 3 ends the iterations with status -1 instead of proceeding
defects.trigger: any problem for which solveCobraLP returns stat 3 for a sub-problem (ibm_cplex codes 5, 6, 10-12, 21, 22; matlab linprog exitflag -1); reproduced with a stand-in solveCobraLP returning stat 3
defects.observed: (R2025a, stand-in solveCobraLP, 2026-11-23) the sub-problem prints 'LPsolution.stat == 3, proceeding ...' and keeps the solution, but line 906 'case 1 || 3' is 'case true' (matches stat 1 only); stat 3 falls to otherwise: solution.stat = -1, solution.x = previous iterate
defects.expected: stat 3 handled as stat 1 as lines 1059 and 1159 intend (case {1, 3})

defects.title: The random warm start is not protected against infinite bounds
defects.trigger: problem with lb = [-inf; -inf] (p = 2, A = [1 1], b = 1, 'E', ub = [2; 2], c = 0), rng(1), param.printLevel = 1
defects.observed: (R2025a, gurobi, 2026-11-23) start is -Inf where lb is -Inf (line 741 uses lb2, not the clipped minlb2 of lines 736-739); first iteration prints ||dx|| = Inf, del_obj = NaN; result unaffected (stat 1, obj 1)
defects.expected: a finite random start between minlb2 and maxub2

notes: No test existed; no test calls it directly. Reproduction (MATLAB): stub folder <scratch>/stublp with function sol = solveCobraLP(LP, varargin); sol = struct('full', zeros(size(LP.A,2),1), 'obj', 0, 'stat', 3, 'origStat', 5, 'origStatText', 'almost', 'solver', 'stub', 'basis', []); end; problem = struct('p', 2, 'q', 0, 'r', 0, 'A', [1 1], 'b', 1, 'csense', 'E', 'lb', [0;0], 'ub', [2;2], 'c', [0;0]); rng(1); optimizeCardinality(problem) -> stat 1 with gurobi; addpath(stub folder); rng(1); optimizeCardinality(problem) -> prints 'proceeding', returns stat -1, origStat 5. With gurobi (the only usable LP solver here besides glpk/pdco) LP status 3 never occurs (gurobiLpQpStatus maps to 1/0/2/-1), so the defect is reachable only with ibm_cplex or matlab linprog, neither available here. Quarantine reach: not confined to a call form (depends on the solver's status), so every caller in the ledger reaches it (checkThermoFeasibility, findFluxConsistentSubset, findMassLeaksAndSiphons, findMinimalLeakageMode*, findRxnsFromMets, findSparsePathway, fitExperimentalFlux, leakTest, maxCardinalityConservationVector, minCardinalityConservationRelaxationVector, optCardThermo, optimalConservationVectors, optimizeCbModel (minNorm 'zero' only)). LEAD DECISION: if graded limitation (status mapping reachable only with solvers not installed), the function would be TESTED; a full test (1204 lines, ~627 executable) was NOT written. Other observations (not graded): many dead lines (if 0 blocks, statements after error, the else of if 1, line 'if ~isempty(warningMessage) & 0'); missing b or csense errors at the deal of line 465 before the documented warning-and-stat -1 checks can run; 'if ltp~=ltq && ltq~=ltr' should be ||; warning text 'weight vector d' for o.
confirmed_by: lead (read the code: line 906 'case 1 || 3' evaluates to case true, which matches stat 1 only, so an LP status 3 goes to otherwise and stat -1 is returned; default seed: reached only when the LP solver returns status 3, which calling code cannot recognise; writer's reproduction with a stand-in solveCobraLP)
